links.outcome: Allied health staff AI knowledge, prior AI education, and desire for training
links.effect: 87% (201/231) had little to no AI knowledge; 82.3% (190/231) had received no AI education; 73.6% (170/231) desired training; 77.1% named workforce knowledge and skill as the greatest challenge.
links.quote: Most participants had not received education on AI (190/231, 82.3%) and desired training (170/231, 73.6%) and believed AI would improve health care.

screen.reason: Survey of allied health professionals regarding perceptions, readiness, and workforce knowledge challenges surrounding AI implementation in clinical practice.
